title: Reinstating an Expired Self-Pay Visit Package
content:
**Reinstatement of an expired Self-Pay Visit Package.** An expired package is reinstated on the patient's request within the reinstatement window; the reinstatement returns it to active status, credits back the visits removed at its expiry and sets the new expiry date the tier's reinstatement extension in calendar days after the reinstatement date. Reinstatement needs the reinstatement charge paid at the reinstatement, and the charge is booked as a reinstatement-fee payment.

**Observable effect.** The patient sees the package active again, with the restored visits available and the new expiry date; its closing details are cleared, and the package history shows a reinstatement-fee payment and a visit credit for the reinstatement.

## Situation of use and capability

The tool reinstates an expired self-pay visit package against the reinstatement charge the patient pays on the call. It takes the charge as a reinstatement-fee payment on the package, credits back the stated number of visits that the expiry removed, returns the package to active status with its closing details cleared, and sets its new expiry date.

## How it is invoked

`reinstate_visit_package_76109996` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `package_id` | the visit package reference number of the expired package, read from the visit package lookup | identifier |
| `reinstatement_fee` | the reinstatement charge collected | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | how the patient pays the charge | one of `card` (a credit or debit card), `cash` (cash at the clinic front desk), `check` (a paper check), `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings or flexible spending account card) |
| `visits_restored` | the visits credited back to the package | non-negative integer (visits) |
| `new_expiry_date` | the package's new last day of use | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` "reinstated", `package_id`, `payment_event_id` (reference number of the reinstatement-fee payment entry), `credit_event_id` (reference number of the visit credit entry), `reinstatement_fee` (USD, 2 decimals), `visits_remaining` (visits now available) and `expiry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
